findings.highlight: I blink at the sudden illumination.
findings.evidenceJa: 不意打ちに視線を泳がす。
findings.governingReading: Caught off guard he lets gaze dart/swim at sudden illumination.

findings.highlight: "More people will die. She'll suck up the magical energy from anyone around her, just like when she attacked me at school.
findings.evidenceJa: 「犠牲者が出るかもね。学校でわたしを襲った時みたいに、目に付いた人から魔力を奪いかねないわ。
findings.governingReading: 犠牲者が出るかも and 奪いかねない warn victims may occur and she could drain passersby, as school incident.
findings.explanation: Possible casualties and risky draining become certain deaths and certain attack.

findings.highlight: "Okay. But Shirou, Sakura left on her own because she didn't want you to see her. She did it to protect you. She's scared and she doesn't want to die, but she wants to settle things on her own, as a Holy Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そう。けどシロウ。サクラが一人で外に出たのは、シロウに見られたくなかったからだよ。サクラはシロウを守る為に、怖いけど、死にたくないけど、聖杯である自分自身に決着をつけにいったの。
findings.governingReading: Sakura went to settle 自分自身, herself as Holy Grail, despite fear of death, protecting Shirou.
findings.explanation: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.

findings.highlight: Are you still afraid to kill her, Shirou?"
findings.evidenceJa: それでも—サクラを殺すのはイヤなの、シロウ？」
findings.governingReading: Even so is killing Sakura something you dislike/refuse, she asks.
findings.explanation: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.

findings.evidenceJa: 「……たとえ、どんなに変わり果ててしまっても。
findings.governingReading: However radically she is transformed, if Illya remains inside he recognizes known person.
findings.explanation: No matter how altered becomes no matter how it ends.
